crossRefs.note: Praise Yah! I will give thanks to Yahweh with my whole heart, in the council of the upright, and in the congregation.
crossRefs.keyword: Praise ye the Lord. Heb. Hallelujah

crossRefs.note: Praise Yah, for it is good to sing praises to our God; for it is pleasant and fitting to praise him.

crossRefs.note: Praise Yah! Praise God in his sanctuary! Praise him in his heavens for his acts of power!
crossRefs.keyword: Praise ye the Lord. Heb. Hallelujah

crossRefs.note: The fear of Yahweh is the beginning of wisdom. All those who do his work have a good understanding. His praise endures…
They have hands, but they don’t feel. They have feet, but they don’t walk, neither do they speak through their throat.
Blessed is everyone who fears Yahweh, who walks in his ways.
He will fulfill the desire of those who fear him. He also will hear their cry, and will save them.
Who among you fears Yahweh and obeys the voice of his servant? He who walks in darkness and has no light, let him trust…
His mercy is for generations of generations on those who fear him.
Blessed is the man who doesn’t walk in the counsel of the wicked, nor stand on the path of sinners, nor sit in the seat…
but his delight is in Yahweh’s law. On his law he meditates day and night.
I delight to do your will, my God. Yes, your law is within my heart.”
I will delight myself in your statutes. I will not forget your word.
Direct me in the path of your commandments, for I delight in them.
I will delight myself in your commandments, because I love them.
I reach out my hands for your commandments, which I love. I will meditate on your statutes.
Their heart is as callous as the fat, but I delight in your law.
How I love your law! It is my meditation all day.
Trouble and anguish have taken hold of me. Your commandments are my delight.
For I delight in God’s law after the inward man,
For the mind of the flesh is death, but the mind of the Spirit is life and peace;

translations.web: Praise Yah! Blessed is the man who fears Yahweh, who delights greatly in his commandments.
translations.bsb: Hallelujah! Blessed is the man who fears the LORD, who greatly delights in His commandments.
translations.kjv: Praise ye the LORD. Blessed is the man that feareth the LORD, that delighteth greatly in his commandments.
translations.asv: Praise ye Jehovah. Blessed is the man that feareth Jehovah, That delighteth greatly in his commandments.
